title: Mouse holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- mouse body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='22' ry='18' fill='#9b7ec8'/>
  <!-- mouse head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='45' rx='16' ry='14' fill='#b89ae0'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='33' rx='9' ry='10' fill='#b89ae0'/>
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='33' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#f0a0c0'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='33' rx='9' ry='10' fill='#b89ae0'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='33' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#f0a0c0'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='44' r='3' fill='#1a1a3a'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='44' r='3' fill='#1a1a3a'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='43' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='43' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='#f06090'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <line x1='30' y1='48' x2='40' y2='50' stroke='#d0b0f0' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='30' y1='53' x2='40' y2='52' stroke='#d0b0f0' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='70' y1='48' x2='60' y2='50' stroke='#d0b0f0' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='70' y1='53' x2='60' y2='52' stroke='#d0b0f0' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- arms holding heart -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='60' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#b89ae0' transform='rotate(-20 36 60)'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='60' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#b89ae0' transform='rotate(20 64 60)'/>
  <!-- heart -->
  <path d='M50 68 C50 68, 40 58, 40 52 C40 48, 44 46, 47 48 C49 49, 50 52, 50 52 C50 52, 51 49, 53 48 C56 46, 60 48, 60 52 C60 58, 50 68, 50 68 Z' fill='#ff4060'/>
  <path d='M46 52 C46 50, 48 49, 49 50' fill='none' stroke='#ff8090' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='85' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#9b7ec8'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='85' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#9b7ec8'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M72 78 C82 78, 85 68, 78 62' fill='none' stroke='#c0a0e0' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
